name: stories
description: Stories library web app, hosted on Firebase

scripts.build:site: npm run build -w apps/site && npm run build:member -w apps/web
scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-stories
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run build:site && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore,functions,storage --project stories-for-all
scripts.test:functions: npm --prefix functions run test:unit && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-stories --only firestore,auth,storage "npm --prefix functions run test:emulator"
scripts.deploy:site: npm run build:site && firebase deploy --only hosting:site --project stories-for-all
